Marunadan Malayali‘ഇത് എന്റെ അവസാന ലോകകപ്പ്’; 2027ൽ കിരീടത്തിനായി എന്തും ചെയ്യാൻ തയ്യാറെന്ന് കോഹ്ലി Indian Express - Malayalam'ഇന്ത്യയ്ക്കായി കളിക്കുന്ന അവസാന ലോകകപ്പ്'; 2027ലെ ഏകദിന ലോകകപ്പോടെ വിരമിക്കുമെന്ന് കോലി manoramanews.com'കോലിക്കും രോഹിതിനുംവേണ്ടി മാത്രമല്ല ക്രിക്കറ്റ് കാണുന്നത്, ജനപ്രീതി കൂടുകയാണ് ചെയ്തത്‌'-സെവാഗ് Mathrubhumi'എന്തിനും തയ്യാറാണ്, 2027 എന്റെ അവസാന ലോകകപ്പായിരിക്കും

items.headline: Why earwigs infected by parasitic worms head towards water
items.teaser: Earwigs, small, elongated insects with distinctive pincers at the rear of their abdomens, have little reason to enter open water. While m…
items.story: Earwigs, small, elongated insects with distinctive pincers at the rear of their abdomens, have little reason to enter open water. While many earwig species are attracted to damp environments, they typically avoid open water. Yet past studies have found that European earwigs infected with a parasitic roundworm called Mermis nigrescens tend to head toward open water. The molecular and biological reasons for this unusual behavior have not been fully uncovered.

items.story: Scientists discovered a surprising energy paradox in the brain during REM sleep, the stage most closely associated with dreaming. The finding suggests that dreaming may require such intense internal processing that neurons consume energy faster than it can be replenished.

items.story: CERN has started replacing some of the Large Hadron Collider’s most important magnets as part of its High-Luminosity upgrade. The new superconducting magnets will produce fields about 40% stronger, allowing particle beams to be squeezed more tightly before they collide. That should create far more collisions for the ATLAS and CMS experiments to analyze, giving physicists a much larger window into the fundamental workings of the universe.
